lessons.title: 1. Relational Operators
lessons.description: Python provides comparison operators: `==` (equal), `!=` (not equal), `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`. Write `is_equal(a, b)` and `is_greater(a, b)`.

lessons.title: 2. Chained Comparisons
lessons.description: Python allows chaining comparisons like `min_val <= x <= max_val`. Write `in_range(x, low, high)`.

lessons.title: 3. Black Jack (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Implement Black Jack card counting rules using relational comparisons.
learning_objectives: Model value rules and edge cases with comparison expressions

lessons.title: 4. Rollercoaster Entry Check (Practice)
lessons.description: Determine if a person can ride a rollercoaster: `age >= 10` and `height_cm >= 130`.
